    p = case['payload']
    indices = p['word_token_indices']
    scores = p['word_scores']
    forced = set(p['forced_words'])
    budget = p['token_budget']
    n = len(indices)
    masks = []
    for lst in indices:
        m = 0
        for t in lst:
            m |= 1 << t
        masks.append(m)
    best_score = -1
    best_mask = 0
    for s in range(1 << n):
        ok = True
        for f in forced:
            if not (s >> f & 1):
                ok = False
                break
        if not ok:
            continue
        union = 0
        total = 0
        for i in range(n):
            if s >> i & 1:
                union |= masks[i]
                total += scores[i]
        if union.bit_count() <= budget and total > best_score:
            best_score = total
            best_mask = s
    result = [i for i in range(n) if (best_mask >> i) & 1]
    return result"}
